title: Regression Watchdog: schedule evaluation suites for model pin and config events
creator: Nina Patel
description:
Problem: We currently rely on manual or ad-hoc evals when model versions or serving configs change. That delays detection of quality regressions and places operational burden on PMs/SEs.

Goal: Implement a lightweight 'Regression Watchdog' orchestration layer that listens for model pin upgrades and serving-configuration diffs (both for Redwood catalog models and customer-pinned models) and schedules appropriate evaluation workflows automatically. The system should support quick smoke checks for fast gating, full regression suites for post-deploy verification, and canary-based evaluation for staged rollouts.

Scope:
- Trigger types: model version pin changes, model config diffs (quantization, sequence length caps, tokenizer substitutions, sampling defaults), route-level model swaps, and rollback events.
- Targets: catalog models (Redwood-managed) and customer-pinned models (private deployments/Dedicated).
- Evaluation profiles: smoke (fast, low-cost), regression (comprehensive), and canary (subset of traffic with production prompts).
- Integration points: model catalog service, pin management API, rollout/orchestration, Redwood Evals pipeline, Console dashboards and alerts, and audit logs.
- Outcomes: pass/fail signal, delta metrics (ROUGE/BLEU/EMBED sim/custom metrics), artifact links to eval run, decision options (block rollout, send warn-only, schedule rollback).

Non-goals: automatic model-level retraining, manual remediation steps, and full remediation automation on first rollout iteration.
acceptance_criteria: Watchdog receives pin-change and config-diff events from catalog and customer pin APIs
Smoke evals start within configured SLA (<=30s enqueue + <=5m execution for smoke profile)
Eval results are attached to the pin/change event and visible in Console as a regression card
Configurable thresholds per project that trigger: block, warn, or proceed with rollout
Canary traffic evals can be enabled per-rollout and produce traffic-sampled metrics
Audit log entry created for every triggered eval linking the artifact and decision outcome
Fallback path: if eval infra is unavailable, honor configured fail-open or fail-closed policy per project
tasks: Spec: define event schema for pin and config-change notifications (PM+Eng)
Design: watchdog orchestration API and evaluation profile mapping (Eng + Evals team)
Implementation: event listener + scheduler service that enqueues Evals runs
Integrate: attach eval artifacts to pin object in catalog and to rollout UI
Console: regression card UI + alerting rules + capability to view raw eval outputs
Policy: per-organization config UI for thresholds and fail-open vs fail-closed handling
Testing: unit tests, integration tests with Evals runner, and an end-to-end canary test
Docs: Runbook + user guide for PMs/SEs + example policies for typical workloads
